args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production was unhealthy, failing health checks with an 18% error rate in all regions. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, at 2024 rollback. Service is now restored to v2.3.0. Root cause of regression in v2.3.1 still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Confirmed the failure**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all production regions.
2. **Rolled back** to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that had been healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback, and verification status; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: The root cause of the regression in v2.3.1 remains under investigation and is captured in the incident.
